# GDPR DPA Generator for SaaS

> A free browser tool for SaaS companies acting as a processor. It generates a customer-specific GDPR Article 28 data processing agreement draft for EU or EEA business customers, then lets you review, correct, copy and print it.

## What it does

- Generates one processor-side DPA draft per customer from structured processing facts.
- Selects clauses on the server for Article 28 processor obligations, processing details, sub-processors, transfers, security, breach notice, termination, audit and assistance.
- Offers server-generated alternative clauses for review, with a short reason tag when you apply one.
- Copies the full reviewed draft to the clipboard and prints it with the browser.
- Keeps local workspace references for up to 20 customers, storing processing presets and result metadata without party details or document text.
- Supports two transfer paths: EEA only, or outside the EEA with the EU Standard Contractual Clauses already chosen by the user.

## How it works

1. Enter the legal names and addresses of the customer (controller) and the SaaS provider (processor).
2. Describe the service, processing purposes, personal data categories and data subject categories.
3. Choose the sub-processor authorization model and list up to 10 sub-processors.
4. Choose the transfer path.
5. Select security measures, breach notification hours and termination handling.
6. Generate the draft, review each clause, and apply alternatives where they fit.
7. Copy or print the draft for review and signature.

## Coverage formula

`coverage_ratio = generated_applicable_count / applicable_required_total`

The denominator is set by the server for the submitted fact pattern. The ratio is a template coverage indicator, not a GDPR compliance score or a legal opinion.

## Scope and limits

- The output is a starting draft for review. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee GDPR compliance.
- The tool does not sign, send or track agreements, and does not record customer acceptance.
- The tool does not select SCC modules or produce a transfer impact assessment.
- Review by qualified counsel is required before signature.
- All generator features are free in this MVP.
